_comment: The nightly workflow's shape (CI v5, docs/CI.md).
PR and push-to-main runs (ci.yml) run only the smoke classes from
smoke-suite.json. The nightly workflow (nightly.yml) runs everything:
every unit class EXCEPT nightly_only_unit, split into unit_shards balanced
jobs; nightly_only_unit with three repeats; and the whole UI suite in
nightly_ui_shards jobs. scripts/plan-tests.py hosted validates this file
against the discovered inventory on every PR and every nightly run, and
puts every discovered class in exactly one of those lists, so a renamed
class fails the plan and no class can drop out of both workflows.
nightly_only_unit holds the timing/performance/dormancy families: they
measure scheduling and rendering behaviour, so they run with repeats and
a longer per-test allowance instead of in the unit shards.
Shard counts are bounded by GitHub's 5 concurrent macOS jobs per account:
a nightly run already queues some of its jobs, which is fine at night.
